15	# Draw Paper Figure — 学术图表生成（Worker 执行）
16	
17	Worker 收到画图任务时读本 skill。**画图前必读** `skills/global/paper-visualization.skill.md` 的 L1/L2 原则和 L3 pattern 库。
18	
19	本 skill 提供：
20	- 通用样式（rcParams + 色板）
21	- 三个常用图表的起点模板（reliability/heatmap/scatter）
22	- NeurIPS 经验提炼的 pattern 实现示例
23	
24	## 输入字段（从 Paper Agent 传入）
25	
26	- `fig_id` / `type` / `placement` / `data_source` / `aspect_ratio` / 输出路径
27	- **`narrative_intent`**：一句话，这张图要让读者相信什么
28	- **`design_notes`**：从 paper-visualization L3 选的 pattern 列表
29	
30	## 画图工作流
31	
32	1. 读 paper-visualization skill 的 L1 防丑原则 + L2 叙事原则
33	2. 根据 `narrative_intent` 选起点模板（本 skill §模板）
34	3. 按 `design_notes` 中每个 pattern 添加相应技法（本 skill §pattern 实现）
35	4. 提交前过本 skill §checklist
36	
37	## 通用样式标准（所有图表必须遵守）

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

stages = [
    {"title": "Source Data",
     "desc": "LLMBar Natural +\nAdversarial (n=100)"},
    {"title": "Counterfactual\nGeneration",
     "desc": "Qwen3-32B\nstyle rewriter",
     "sub": "formal ↔ casual pairs"},
    {"title": "NLI Content\nVerification",
     "desc": "DeBERTa-v3-large",
     "sub": "threshold ≥ 0.90,\ndirection-aware"},
    {"title": "Dual Pairwise\nScoring",
     "desc": "LLM Judge\n(position A/B swap)",
     "sub": "2 trials per pair"},
    {"title": "Statistical\nAnalysis",
     "desc": "BT model + GEE\ndecomposition",
     "sub": "+ Likert comparison"},
]

attrition = [
    "n=100 pairs",
    "200 counterfactuals",
    "88 NLI-pass pairs",
    "173 valid comparisons",
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5, 2.6))
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, 11.8)
ax.set_ylim(-0.4, 2.2)
ax.axis('off')

box_w = 1.75
box_h = 1.65
gap = 0.55
y_center = 0.85
y_bot = y_center - box_h / 2

positions = []
for i in range(5):
    x = i * (box_w + gap)
    positions.append(x)

stage_fill = '#F5F5F5'
stage_edge = '#333333'

for i, (x, stage) in enumerate(zip(positions, stages)):
    box = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x, y_bot), box_w, box_h,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.08,rounding_size=0.12",
        facecolor=stage_fill, edgecolor=stage_edge, linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=3,
    )
    ax.add_patch(box)

    circle_r = 0.14
    cx, cy = x + 0.2, y_bot + box_h - 0.2
    circle = plt.Circle((cx, cy), circle_r, facecolor=stage_edge,
                         edgecolor='none', zorder=4)
    ax.add_patch(circle)
    ax.text(cx, cy, str(i + 1), color='white', fontsize=8,
            fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='center', zorder=5)

    title_y = y_bot + box_h - 0.42
    ax.text(x + box_w / 2, title_y, stage["title"],
            fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', ha='center', va='top',
            zorder=4, linespacing=1.15)

    desc_y = title_y - 0.35
    if "\n" in stage["title"]:
        desc_y -= 0.12
    ax.text(x + box_w / 2, desc_y, stage["desc"],
            fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='top', color='#444444',
            zorder=4, linespacing=1.15)

    if "sub" in stage:
        sub_y = y_bot + 0.18
        ax.text(x + box_w / 2, sub_y, stage["sub"],
                fontsize=6.5, ha='center', va='center', color='#777777',
                fontstyle='italic', zorder=4, linespacing=1.1)

for i in range(4):
    x_start = positions[i] + box_w + 0.02
    x_end = positions[i + 1] - 0.02
    y_arrow = y_center

    ax.annotate(
        '', xy=(x_end, y_arrow), xytext=(x_start, y_arrow),
        arrowprops=dict(
            arrowstyle='->', color='#555555',
            lw=1.5, mutation_scale=14,
            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0',
        ),
        zorder=2,
    )

    mid_x = (x_start + x_end) / 2
    ax.text(mid_x, y_arrow + 0.28, attrition[i],
            fontsize=6.5, fontstyle='italic', ha='center', va='bottom',
            color='#666666', zorder=4)

outpath = '/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/artifacts/figures/paper/pipeline_diagram.pdf'
plt.savefig(outpath, format='pdf')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
PYEOF
echo "Script written."
